questions.q: What does Andrija say about the bread Andjelka brought?
o: That it wasn't made by a baker but by a car mechanic
questions.e: In the video: "Ovo nije radio pekar, nego automehaničar." — this wasn't made by a baker but by a car mechanic.

o: Eggs and bacon are fine, but the bread must be healthy
questions.e: In the video: "napravili smo kompromis: može jaja, može slanina, ali mora i zdrav hleb" — we made a compromise: eggs are fine, bacon is fine, but healthy bread is a must.

questions.q: How many days, according to Andjelka, should the purchase last?
questions.e: In the video: "Onda treba da traje sedam dana." — then it has to last seven days.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.e: Cigla — a brick. That's what Andrija calls the heavy bread.

questions.q: Trebalo je da ti kupim jednu *kobasicu*, da jedeš,
da mogu da *umačem* ova jaja, da mogu normalno da jedem?

questions.e: It's about a woman: feminine past tense — kupila.

questions.q: Od ___ brašna, sa semenom lana, sa bundevom i tako dalje.
questions.e: The preposition od ("from, of") takes the genitive: od heljdinog brašna.
After the number 5 and above the noun is in the genitive plural: 500 dinara.
